subpages.title: Industrial I/O Modules
subpages.desc: All I/O modules are suited for DIN rail mounting and provide a RS485 serial interface with a Modbus RTU protocol
subpages.text: Skip to Content Currency EUR - Euro USD - US Dollar Language English Italian Sign In Create an Account Toggle Nav My Cart Search Search Advanced Search Search Compare Products Menu Home Compact I/O Modules Webserver I/O Modules Industrial I/O Modules Converters Accessories Account Settings Language English Italian Currency EUR - Euro USD - US Dollar Home Industrial I/O Modules Industrial I/O Modules SS10000 SERIES – Industrial I/O modules with Modbus RTU/ASCII SS10000 includes a series of data acquisition modules with a RS485 interface and a Modbus RTU/ASCII protocol, featuring a low-profile format which makes them suitable for DIN rail mounting inside industrial electrical cabinets. All devices ensure a high accuracy and a stable measurement over time and with changes in temperature. A dual Watch-Dog (hardware and software) looks after the proper operation of the CPU and sets outputs to safety values in case of communication failure. Device configuration is provided via software. Signalling leds allow an immediate diagnosis of device operation. Electrical connections are available via plug-in screw terminals. The full galvanic isolation ensures a good protection against interference present in industrial environments.
